sampling_model.design: The store-or-match action and partner choice use only observed covariates and the auxiliary matching seed, never treatment assignments or orientation signs. Operationally, a stored arrival receives an immediate private fair assignment and a later completing arrival receives the opposite treatment. Conditional on the realized units and matching seed, treatment-blind matching makes this law identical to drawing one independent fair orientation sign after each pair is completed; the potential outcomes remain fixed.
sampling_model.units: An outer iid law for \((X_i,Y_i(0),Y_i(1))\) defines the minimax expected design risk and the unknown prognostic score; it is not used to replace the finite-population causal estimand.
sampling_model.treatment: Every unit is assigned at its arrival and the assignment is never revised. Exactly one unit in each arrival-incidence pair receives treatment and the other receives control; conditional on the completed matching, the pair orientations are independent and each has probability \(1/2\).
sampling_model.overlap: The known marginal treatment probability is \(1/2\) for every unit.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: None. The policy observes covariates only and does not know or estimate \(g\); \(g\) indexes the law class and the offline precision oracle.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 1 identifies adjacent pairing after sorting \(g\) as MSE-optimal among half-treatment stratifications.
Theorems 1--2 give an offline-variance CLT for an uncapped packing reservoir with a negligible unmatched remainder.
Theorem 1 gives an \(O(\log^2 T)\)-competitive general-arrivals line-matching algorithm under unknown iid arrivals.
The pigeonhole theorem bounds geometric discrepancy for immediate cellwise treatment balancing without a reservoir.
Hierarchical Greedy attains dimension-dependent spatial matching rates with initial or replenished supply.
Tree embedding yields an \(O(\log n)\)-competitive algorithm for min-cost perfect matching with delays.

body.tldr: The exact precision loss caused by a hard unmatched-unit reservoir and a common enrollment deadline in online matched-pair randomization is \(R_T(B)\asymp b^{-2\beta/d}+T^{-1}\sum_{r=1}^{b}r^{-2\beta/d}\). Matching decisions use only covariate history, and immediate private assignments admit the deferred representation with one independent fair orientation per completed pair. A fixed-branching nested-grid policy now attains the upper frontier: it uses within-cell matching, geometrically sized coarsening phases, and a pathwise break rule when occupancy equals arrivals remaining. A negatively associated truncated-exponential workload argument proves an exponential clearance tail without treating multinomial cell loads as independent. Together with the all-policy weighted-suffix converse, this gives the matched capacity--deadline frontier and the previously established iff rule that offline first-order precision is attainable exactly when \(B_T\to\infty\).

project_justification.gap: Offline matched-pair theory identifies the prognostic-score oracle, while existing online reservoir, general-arrivals matching, replenished-supply, and delay-matching results do not jointly impose deterministic capacity, arrival-incidence pairing, and forced terminal completion for causal precision regret.
project_justification.niche: The result supplies an additive finite-horizon capacity--deadline frontier under a bounded-density Hölder law class, rather than a tuning heuristic, an uncapped competitive ratio, or an asymptotic statement that discards an unmatched remainder.
project_justification.fill: A weighted-suffix all-policy converse is matched by an explicit fixed-branching coarsening policy. The new workload contraction derives an exponential phase tail under fixed-sample multinomial dependence, while parity and the break rule certify the hard cap and terminal emptying pathwise.

body.related_work: \cite{bai2022optimality} supplies the offline prognostic-score oracle: adjacent pairing after sorting the prognostic sum minimizes conditional MSE among half-treatment stratifications. \cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning} supplies the operational reservoir and the SeqExpMatch consumer, while leaving time- and occupancy-dependent capacity tuning unresolved. Morrison's \emph{Reservoir Designs for Online Paired Experiments}, arXiv:2505.17247v1, gives packing-based asymptotic guarantees for a covariate-determined reservoir but allows a negligible unmatched remainder and does not state a deterministic-cap, forced-empty frontier; see \cite{morrison2025reservoir}. \cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole} supplies cellwise partition and parity ideas without a stored-unmatched reservoir. The fixed-branching bucket/merge/break architecture here is modeled on Algorithm 1 and Sections 3.1--3.2 of \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals}, but their result concerns an uncapped pool and a line-metric competitive ratio; the present exponential workload contraction and hard-cap causal-regret analysis are derived separately. \cite{azarchiplunkarkaplan2017delays} motivates multilevel charging, while its delay objective does not provide endpoint clearance. \cite{kanoria2025dynamicspatial} studies replenished or initially available supply rather than a depleting same-side reservoir. \cite{bairomanoshaikh2022inference}, \cite{bailiutabordmeehan2024tuples}, and \cite{melnykwangwattenhofer2021kway} remain relevant to inference or multiway extensions but are not theorem-level inputs to this pairwise frontier.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The constants are nonoptimized and can be large because the construction reserves endpoint capacity through the conservative deterministic inequality \(q_0+\sum_j n_j\le b\). The workload proof controls the expected number of break edges and gives exponential phase tails, but it does not give an exact leading constant or computationally optimize the branching and phase multiplier. The result concerns expected conditional design-variance regret; it does not itself supply a central limit theorem or a feasible variance estimator.
body.honest_scope: The proved result is a nonasymptotic minimax order for covariate-only, immediate-assignment, arrival-incidence paired designs with a deterministic reservoir cap and exact terminal emptying. Its upper certificate is the specified fixed-branching grid policy, and its lower certificate ranges over every randomized policy in \(\Pi_{T,B}\). No claim is made about outcome-adaptive score learning, response-adaptive CARA matching, multiarm tuples, exact leading constants, or Wald inference. A constant prognostic score still makes every per-law matching regret zero; the positive minimax frontier is a uniform statement over the Hölder class.
